card.title: Invisible Hierarchy
card.instruction: Treat every interaction as evidence of an unseen hierarchy and keep identifying who truly outranks whom.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You fetched her coffee. So she's above you on the chart.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Unpaid tribute. A very secure position for her.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then this is a rotating monarchy.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 infers rank from coffee fetching, A3 preserves that hierarchy despite kindness, and A5 reclassifies reciprocal favors as rotating sovereignty.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's kindness explanation becomes A3's tribute reading; B4's reciprocal coffee requires A5's rotating hierarchy.

relationship.evidence: B2 explains an ordinary kind act and B4 offers concrete counterevidence from yesterday.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4's reversal to alter the hierarchy model rather than abandon hierarchy; the practical situation changes little.

specificity.evidence: A1 identifies who fetched whose coffee, and B4 supplies the reversed favor needed for the ending.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's rotating monarchy is a brief consequence of B4's reciprocal service.
